Plate diameter in the image is about 400 px. Judging by the size, it is probably a dinner plate of about 26 cm, so roughly 15 px per cm.

The egg pile is about 230 px wide by 260 px tall, which is roughly 15 x 17 cm. It is irregular, so the real footprint is about 150 cm². At an average height of about 2.5 cm that is about 375 cm³. Scrambled egg is fluffy, so I'd put the density near 0.7 g/cm³, giving about 260 g. That seems high. The pile is probably lower, around 2 cm, and the footprint closer to 130 cm². That gives about 260 cm³ at 0.75 g/cm³, or roughly 195 g. I'll say about 180 g of scrambled egg.

Other visible items:
- Spinach or arugula leaves mixed in: about 10 g.
- Cherry tomato pieces: about 10 g.
- Cheese crumbles (feta-like): about 10 g.
